description: QSS with $220,000 Medicare wages and $10,000 taxable interest — Additional Medicare uses $200k, NIIT uses $250k (G9).
derivation: Form 8959 threshold for QSS is $200,000: 0.9% × $20,000 = $180. Form 8960 NIIT threshold for QSS is $250,000; MAGI $230,000 is under it, so NIIT is $0. MFJ would have used $250,000 for both.
